question:
Alice, Bob, and Claire are holding a white elephant gift exchange. At the start of the event, they are each holding a present of a different color: Alice has a grey present, Bob has a blue present, and Claire has a white present.
As the event progresses, pairs of people swap gifts. First, Bob and Claire swap their gifts. Then, Bob and Alice swap their gifts. Finally, Claire and Bob swap their gifts. At the end of the event, Claire has the
Options:
(A) grey present
(B) blue present
(C) white present
solution:
Present colors in order (Alice, Bob, Claire):
Initial: (grey, blue, white)
1. Bob and Claire swap: (grey, white, blue)
2. Bob and Alice swap: (white, grey, blue)
3. Claire and Bob swap: (white, blue, grey)
Claire has the grey present, option (A).
Final answer: (A)
